reason: Repair the second fresh design-review findings: validate schema identifiers, versions, types and exact record paths; bind title authority to a digest-linked structured decision; constrain retained text; and prove RFC3339 UTC chronology.

lanes.proof_role: Prove exact schema IDs, versions, field types, record paths, artwork/source bytes and properties, allocation, digest-linked title research, truthful pending gates, and every actual BASE...HEAD, staged, unstaged, and untracked path against the declared allowlist.

Reject unknown fields, invalid pending nullability, unbounded or invalid scalar grammar, non-classified retained authority text, prohibited values, credentials, private mailbox content, codes, and private-key material across exact JSON and bounded Markdown.

Fail closed unless the digest-bound structured title decision approves the exact title, concrete classified rights evidence and mailbox control/receive/provider/retention evidence agree, and all decision/evidence timestamps are RFC3339 UTC in valid chronology; status changes alone cannot pass.
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred and expected to fail while operator title, rights confirmation, or mailbox control/receive evidence remains pending; publication is prohibited until this exact lane passes.

lanes.proof_role: Prove patch hygiene after the validator has independently proved the complete actual path set against the immutable current-main preparation base.
